proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1298 article gives Malayalam kal, kallu stone, rock, precious stone; kalla glass beads; kallan mason; hard-hearted.. The Byari survey form kallɨ “stone or rock” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
